verdict.rationale: Scribe documents several selectable models: zoom-scribe-multilingual, whisper for 26 more locales, and zoom-scribe-en-pro, which it describes qualitatively as giving 'higher English accuracy'. The evidence contains no published accuracy figures, latency comparisons or per-model pricing, so the tradeoff part of the story is largely unevidenced. Fast, live and batch are processing modes, not model choices, so they do not substitute for model-level tradeoffs. Missing for 10: published per-model accuracy benchmarks (e.g. WER), documented per-model latency, per-model cost/pricing, a consolidated model comparison table, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Recognizes ten languages with the zoom-scribe-multilingual model and 26 additional locales with the whisper model
For higher English accuracy, select the Pro option, Scribe API Pro High-Accuracy, with the model ID zoom-scribe-en-pro.
